Asa is a Retirement Castle resident. Homer knows him after a short while in the retirement home. He is seen playing cards with Beatrice and Hatty. He appears in the Retirement Castle with Gladys, Jasper and Prudence.

page.overview:
Who is Asa?

Asa is a Retirement Castle resident. Homer knows him after a short while in the retirement home. He is seen playing cards with Beatrice and Hatty. He appears in the Retirement Castle with Gladys, Jasper and Prudence.
